message_def.name: SetElement
message_def.description: This message is used to add, insert or replace one or more elements in a list. Each element is uniquely identified by the UID, and the sequence within the list is specified by the previous (parent) and next (child) elements. This message can also be used to update an existing element.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: ID of the request. This ID will be returned in the response message.

fixed_field.name: ElementUID
fixed_field.interpretation: Values zero (0) and 65535 are invalid (reserved).

fixed_field.name: PreviousUID
fixed_field.interpretation: UID of the previous (parent) element in the list. The value is zero (0) if this is the first (head) element.

fixed_field.name: NextUID
fixed_field.interpretation: UID of the next (child) element in the list. The value is zero (0) if this is the last (tail) element.

variable_format_field.name: ElementData
variable_format_field.interpretation: Element data to be added to the list

message_def.name: DeleteElement
message_def.description: This message is used to delete one or more elements from a list. Each element is uniquely identified by the UID.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: ID of the request. This ID will be returned in the response message.

fixed_field.name: ElementUID
fixed_field.interpretation: UID of the element to be deleted, where a value of 65535 represents all element in the list.

message_def.name: QueryElement
message_def.description: This message is used to query an element from a list. The element is uniquely identified by the UID.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: ElementUID
fixed_field.interpretation: UID of the queried element. A value of zero (0) represents the first (head) element in the list.

message_def.name: QueryElementList
message_def.description: This message is used to query all elements from a list.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: QueryElementCount
message_def.description: This message is used to query the number of elements in a list.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: ConfirmElementRequest
message_def.description: This message is used to confirm successful operation on an element list.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: ID of the request that generated this confirmation message.

message_def.name: RejectElementRequest
message_def.description: This message is used to reject an operation on an element list.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: ID of the request that generated this confirmation message.

fixed_field.name: ResponseCode
fixed_field.interpretation: ID of the request that generated this confirmation message.

message_def.name: ReportElement
message_def.description: This message is used to report a single element from a list. The element is uniquely identified by the UID, while it's position within the list is denoted by the previous (parent) and next (child) elements. The message data is identical to the Element Record in ID 041Ah: SetElement.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: ElementUID
fixed_field.interpretation: Values zero (0) and 65535 are invalid (reserved).

fixed_field.name: PreviousUID
fixed_field.interpretation: UID of the previous (parent) element in the list. The value is zero (0) if this is the first (head) element.

fixed_field.name: NextUID
fixed_field.interpretation: UID of the next (child) element in the list. The value is zero (0) if this is the last (tail) element.

variable_format_field.name: ElementData
variable_format_field.interpretation: Element data to be added to the list

message_def.name: ReportElementList
message_def.description: This message is used to report the UIDs for all elements in a list.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: ElementUID
fixed_field.interpretation: UID of the elements in the list.

message_def.name: ReportElementCount
message_def.description: This message is used to report the number of elements in a list.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: ElementCount
fixed_field.interpretation: Number of elements currently in the list
